newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Grenade kills one, wounds 22 in Manila market.
newsitem.headline: Grenade kills one, wounds 22 in Manila market.

text.p: One person was killed and 22 others wounded when an unidentified attacker threw a grenade on Tuesday at a public market in the Manila district of Pasig, Philippine police said. The grenade thrower escaped.
Police said they were investigating the possibility the attack might have been the result of a previous quarrel between two vendor groups working in the market.
